places.description: Cancún is a resort city on Mexico's Caribbean coast, known for its hotel zone, white-sand beaches, and nightlife.
places.name: Cancún

places.description: Chichén Itzá is a UNESCO-listed Maya archaeological city in Yucatán, famed for the stepped pyramid El Castillo.
places.name: Chichén Itzá

places.description: Chuburná is a quiet fishing village on Yucatán's Gulf coast west of Progreso, known for its beaches and summer homes.
places.name: Chuburná

places.description: Isla Mujeres is a small island off Cancún, known for Playa Norte's calm turquoise waters and snorkeling reefs.
places.name: Isla Mujeres

places.description: Mérida is the colonial capital of Yucatán state, known for its pastel mansions, Maya heritage, and lively plazas.
places.name: Mérida

places.description: Mucuyché is a village south of Mérida, known for its restored henequen hacienda and crystal-clear cenotes open to swimmers.
places.name: Mucuyché

places.description: Oxkintok is a Maya archaeological site near Maxcanú in Yucatán, known for its early pyramids and the Tzat Tun Tzat labyrinth.
places.name: Oxkintok

places.description: Playa del Carmen is a beach city on the Riviera Maya, known for pedestrian Quinta Avenida and ferries to Cozumel.
places.name: Playa del Carmen

places.description: San Miguel de Cozumel is the main town on Cozumel island, known for its waterfront malecón, dive shops, and cruise port.
places.name: San Miguel de Cozumel

places.description: Valladolid is a colonial town in eastern Yucatán, known for its pastel facades, Cenote Zací, and proximity to Chichén Itzá.
places.name: Valladolid

places.description: Xcaret Park is an eco-archaeological theme park near Playa del Carmen, known for underground rivers, wildlife, and Mexican cultural shows.
places.name: Xcaret Park
